title: Razlo failed his exams

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: You. It all went wrong since I first spoke with you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You. It all went wrong since I first spoke with you.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: It seems the corporate-sponsored academia phase of my life has run its course, and rather more quickly than I'd hoped.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It seems the corporate-sponsored academia phase of my life has run its course, and rather more quickly than I'd hoped.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Yes, the time for childish mockery has arrived. Please revel in it. This is your moment to shine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, the time for childish mockery has arrived. Please revel in it. This is your moment to shine.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I doubt that's sincere... but if it is, then thank you. I suppose.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I doubt that's sincere... but if it is, then thank you. I suppose.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Wondrous insight. You should be a detective.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wondrous insight. You should be a detective.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I didn't bribe the enrollment department enough to fast track my application ahead of my rivals. But as one door closes, another opens. I have another job offer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't bribe the enrollment department enough to fast track my application ahead of my rivals. But as one door closes, another opens. I have another job offer.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: No. I'm joining a violent street gang.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. I'm joining a violent street gang.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: My father was a Doctor. I think I want to be one too. I'll focus on treating people who can't afford augments or MedTech.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My father was a Doctor. I think I want to be one too. I'll focus on treating people who can't afford augments or MedTech.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I'm quite serious. I'm under no illusions about my nature. I'm smart, ruthless, unpleasant to be around and... I want to do SOMETHING with my life. If the corps don't want me, I can use my talents elsewhere, and perhaps for the greater good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm quite serious. I'm under no illusions about my nature. I'm smart, ruthless, unpleasant to be around and... I want to do SOMETHING with my life. If the corps don't want me, I can use my talents elsewhere, and perhaps for the greater good.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: There's plenty of work ahead, but this course feels... fresh at least. And whether you speak to me for your own amusement or out of genuine interest in my plight, I do not consider our talks unpleasant.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's plenty of work ahead, but this course feels... fresh at least. And whether you speak to me for your own amusement or out of genuine interest in my plight, I do not consider our talks unpleasant.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I hope next time we speak I'll be in better spirits, and you'll bring better luck.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hope next time we speak I'll be in better spirits, and you'll bring better luck.
What went wrong?
Nice to see you too.
Sorry.
Haha.
You failed the exam?
You didn't study enough?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're not as smart as you glasses suggest?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're not as smart as you glasses suggest?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're not as smart as you glasses suggest?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're not as smart as you glasses suggest?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: CorpSec?
Hospitality?
Children's entertainment?
Obviously.
What, really?
You're still joking right?
Well good luck I guess.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Might have to work on the bedside manner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Might have to work on the bedside manner.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Might have to work on the bedside manner.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Might have to work on the bedside manner.
